title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Rachaad White (heel) active for Week 11
items.desc: Rachaad White (heel) is active for Week 11 for the Washington Commanders against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: White is good to go after passing through pregame tests without any issues, offering head coach Dan Quinn a impactful pass-catching out of the backfield behind the returning Jacory Croskey-Merritt.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) misses walkthrough Monday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III did not participate in Monday's walkthrough practice.
items.impact: It is a short week for the Chiefs on Thursday against the Bills. Walker will need to continue to be monitored in practice on Tuesday after missing the past two weeks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dak Prescott (hand) logs full practice on estimated report Monday
items.desc: Dak Prescott was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Prescott was listed with a hand injury. He should still be good to go for Thursday's game against the Eagles on Thanksgiving.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) cleared to return Monday
items.desc: Micah Parsons (knee) has been cleared to return for the Green Bay Packers Monday according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Parsons is now poised to make his season debut Wednesday night against the Rams, boosting a Green Bay front seven that will look to disrupt quarterback Matthew Stafford and the injury-ravaged Rams offense.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Aaron Banks was a full participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Banks is on track to be good to go for Wednesday's game against the Rams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kevin Zeitler (triceps) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Kevin Zeitler was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Zeitler will need to be monitored on the injury report heading into Wednesday's game against the Rams on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean Rhyan (ankle) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Sean Rhyan was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Rhyan will need to be monitored on the injury report heading into Wednesday's game against the Rams on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skyy Moore (ankle) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Skyy Moore was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Moore will need to be monitored on the injury report heading into Wednesday's game against the Rams on a short week.

items.title: Bo Melton (thigh) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Bo Melton was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Melton will need to be monitored on the injury report heading into Wednesday's game against the Rams on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Zaire Franklin was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Franklin will need to be monitored on the injury report heading into Wednesday's game against the Rams on a short week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs (finger) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Josh Jacobs was limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Jacobs is not expected to be ready to return for Wednesday's game against the Rams. He was still able to practice in limited fashion just two days before the next game for Green Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) practices fully in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Smith hauled in five passes in his return to action on Sunday against the Steelers. He should remain a steady WR2 in a favorable matchup against Dallas.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) practices fully in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Greenard is on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Carter (quad) practices fully in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Jalen Carter was listed as a full participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Carter is on track to be fully good to go for Thursday's game on Thanksgiving against the Cowboys.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Shipley (foot/illness) limited in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Will Shipley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Shipley saw four carries in his return to action on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tanner McKee (rib) limited in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Tanner McKee was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: McKee will continue to backup Joe Milton if he is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dallas Goedert (shin) limited in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Goedert caught just one pass in Sunday's win over the Steelers. His upside appears to be a little more limited with Joe Milton behind center.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Saquon Barkley (neck/illness) limited in estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: Barkley was able to find the end zone in Sunday's win over the Steelers. He should be on track to be good to go despite it being a short week for the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinyon Mitchell (hamstring) DNP from estimated practice Monday
items.desc: Quinyon Mitchell was listed as a DNP on Monday's estimated practice report.
items.impact: It is a short week for the Eagles playing on Thursday. Mitchell is battling a hamstring injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Jones clears waivers, officially a free agent
items.desc: Former Colts QB Daniel Jones cleared waivers and is now officially a free agent.
items.impact: Jones should draw some more interest now that he has cleared waivers. He should sign with a team fairly soon.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) activated from IR
items.desc: The Commanders officially activated RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt from injured reserve.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt will return for Monday's game against the Bengals. He should return to his lead role in the backfield for Washington after missing the past four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf will not be suspended by NFL
items.desc: The NFL is not expected to suspend WR DK Metcalf for his actions after he was ejected from Sunday's game against the Eagles.
items.impact: Metcalf's actions will still be reviewed as part of the league's standard discipline process. He could be fined, but he is not expected to be suspended.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Chris Boswell is perfect on four kicks
items.desc: Chris Boswell made all three field goal attempts and added an extra point in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Boswell has missed five field goals this year, most recently missing one in Week 10. He will be a solid streaming option for Week 12, where he figures to get some opportunities against a stingy Broncos defense that may prevent the offense from reaching the endzone.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST allows 19 points in loss
items.desc: The Pittsburgh Steelers D/ST allowed 19 points and recorded three sacks in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: The Steelers faced the Eagles on a seven-game skid, but weren't to take much advantage of a struggling offense. The Steelers face the improving Broncos on Sunday.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Darnell Washington goes 3/22 in loss
items.desc: Darnell Washington caught all three of his targets for 22 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Washington's yardage total throughout the season has been inconsistent, although this is the fifth game with at least three receptions. Washington won't be fantasy-relevant in Week 12's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Pat Freiermuth totals 40 yards in loss
items.desc: Pat Freiermuth caught five passes for 39 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He also added a rush for one yard.
items.impact: Freiermuth's five receptions ties his season high, and he's only gone above the 40-yard mark twice all season. Right now, Freiermuth is a touchdown-dependent TE2 against the Broncos in Week 12.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Roman Wilson has three catches in return from IR
items.desc: Roman Wilson brought in three passes for 43 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Wilson returned from an IR stint and had the second-most receiving yards on the team. However, he is still at least WR3 on the depth chart, so he won't be fantasy-viable unless things drastically change.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Germie Bernard leads team in targets on Sunday
items.desc: Germie Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Bernard led the Steelers in both receptions and targets on Sunday, where he appeared to be Aaron Rodgers' go-to target throughout the game. Bernard has not demonstrated consistency since his Week 6 breakout versus the Bucs, so he won't be a reliable fantasy asset unless DK Metcalf faces suspension from the NFL.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Max Hurleman shines in career debut
items.desc: Max Hurleman caught six passes for 61 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Hurleman was brought up from the practice squad to aid the Steelers' wide receiver room. With that opportunity, Hurleman lead the team in receptions, yards, and scored the only touchdown for the Steelers. However, he may revert back to the practice squad, so he won't be a viable play in Week 12's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Rico Dowdle has minimal production in loss
items.desc: Rico Dowdle had five rushes for 15 yards and added four catches for 19 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.
items.impact: Dowdle has mostly disappointed this season, logging fewer than 50 all-purpose yards in all but two of his games played this season. He has failed to show the upside he had last year with the Panthers, and has only reached the end zone once all year. Dowdle will be nothing more than a desperation play in Week 12's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Jaylen Warren totals 29 yards in Sunday's loss to Eagles
items.desc: Jaylen Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He had two receptions for one yard.
items.impact: For the second game in a row, Warren has seen minimal production with his touches after he had an eight game stretch where he recorded at least 75 all-purpose yards. He will try to get back on track in Week 12, but he faces a tough Denver defense. He will likely fall in the low-end RB2 range.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Aaron Rodgers leads Steelers in rush yards in Week 11's loss
items.desc: Aaron Rodgers went 30/44 for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's loss to the Eagles. He added five rushes for 29 yards.
items.impact: The almost 43-year-old Rodgers becomes the second-oldest player in NFL history to lead his team in rush yards, only trailing Tom Brady. After a four-game stretch of 11 passing touchdowns, Rodgers has now totaled four in his last four games. Rodgers faces a tough Denver defense on Sunday, where he holds no more than QB2 value.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Philadelphia Eagles record five sacks in win
items.desc: The Philadelphia Eagles D/ST allowed 16 points and had five sacks in Sunday's win over the Steelers.
items.impact: The defense only allowed one touchdown all game against a struggling Steelers offense. However, they face a high powered Cowboys offense in Week 12, so they are not fantasy vialble for that matchup.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Jake Elliott is perfect in win
items.desc: Jake Elliott made 4/4 field goal attempts and one extra point in Sunday's win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Elliott has been perfect in all but one game this season. He will be a solid streaming option against the Cowboys, where the Eagles will do their best to match the high-powered Cowboys offense.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Makai Lemon disappears with only one catch against the Steelers
items.desc: Makai Lemon had one catch for three yards in Sunday's win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Lemon's involvement drastically decreased with the return of DeVonta Smith, as he recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. Lemon faces a good matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday; however, he will be a risky play due to QB Joe Milton's low passing output over the last two games.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Darius Cooper catches goes 4/59 in win
items.desc: Darius Cooper caught 4/5 targets for 59 yards in Sunday's win over the Steelers.
items.impact: Cooper led the wide receiving group in yardage, despite DeVonta Smith's return to the lineup. Cooper faces the Cowboys on Thanksgiving and will likely be a low-end flex play.

items.author: Emily Maingi
items.title: Joe Milton III secures first win as Eagles starter
items.desc: Joe Milton III completed 11/22 passes for 141 yards with no interceptions or touchdowns in Sunday's win over the Steelers. He also added five rushes for nine yards.
items.impact: Milton did just enough to end the Eagles' seven game losing streak. Milton has a much more favorable defensive matchup against the Cowboys on Thursday, but he isn't fantasy-relevant in one quarterback leagues.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) not ruled out for season
items.desc: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said WR Alec Pierce has not been shut down for the season.
items.impact: This comes after a recent report that Pierce had been shut down for the season. Steichen added that Pierce will only return if he is 100 percent healthy, which seems unlikely to happen at this point in the season as the Colts continue to lose games.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) to have surgery, done for 2026
items.desc: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will undergo ankle surgery and is out for the remainder of the 2026 season.
items.impact: Ferguson had a blowup game in Week 2 where he flashed his potential, only to suffer an injury in Week 3 and miss every game since. It a season of things gone wrong for the Rams, and this just piles on top of it all. It looked like they were going to get him back soon only a week or so ago, now he is out for the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Seth McGowan (hamstring) to miss some time
items.desc: Colts RB Seth McGowan is expected to miss "some time" with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: McGowan suffered the injury in last Thursday's loss against the Texans. It is unclear if he is an IR candidate.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten re-aggravates ankle injury, 'wasn't too bad'
items.desc: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said RB Bhayshul Tuten re-aggravated his ankle injury, but it "wasn't too bad."
items.impact: Tuten left Sunday's game against the Giants twice due to apparent injuries. "He's tough as nails. He wants to continue to fight," Coen said of Tuten. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brandon Aiyuk released by San Fransisco 49ers
items.desc: Brandon Aiyuk has been released by the San Fransisco 49ers after a long standoff and holdout situation.
items.impact: Aiyuk is now expected to sign with the Commanders practice squad and re-unite with college QB Jayden Daniels. However, multiple WR needy teams could take the opportunity to take a glance at him, so don't be surprised if rumors abound. We'll get a much better idea of his potential fantasy value once he joins an NFL squad. He hasn't played since 2024, so a slow start would be expected, and his redraft value will likely be minimal, but taking a shot at the upside he might possess is worth it for those with bench space.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Elijah Simmons (concussion) in NFL concussion protocol
items.desc: Elijah Simmons (concussion) is in the NFL's concussion protocol, per HC Todd Bowles.
items.impact: Simmons has played a minimal role this season behind Vita Vea, so his absence won't impact much from an IDP standpoint. It does hurt the Bucs depth, however, and if he is out for next week Rakeem Nunez-Roches will see extra snaps.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tommy DeVito to start Week 12 against the Chargers
items.desc: Tommy DeVito will start for the Patriots in Week 12 against the Chargers.
items.impact: DeVito has some starting experience in the past and has been serviceable, though he's certainly not going to get the offense humming like Drake Maye would. It's a downgrade for the entire offense, and should make for an interesting game against a Chargers team that has started to come alive in recent weeks.
